# Third-party references

This project may refer to external repositories for experiment design, evaluation metrics, and baseline implementations.

## decoding-NLG

- URL: https://github.com/gianwiher/decoding-NLG
- Purpose: experimental setup and evaluation protocol reference
- License: to be confirmed before copying or redistributing code
- Current policy: use as a reference for tasks, metrics, and output format. Avoid vendoring modified code until license is confirmed.

## degen

- URL: https://github.com/ari-holtzman/degen
- Purpose: neural text degeneration and repetition metric reference
- License: GPL-3.0 according to GitHub metadata
- Current policy: if code is copied or modified, preserve license requirements. Prefer reimplementing small metrics independently when possible.

## Policy

- Citing papers and reproducing experimental settings is allowed.
- Copying source code requires license review.
